text: Through a scoping review, a framework has been developed to provide a high-level guide for identifying domains and indicators to measure urban deprivation. While this framework offers a comprehensive understanding of critical non-income factors—such as healthcare, education, housing, basic services, and infrastructure—associated with urban poverty, it does not provide specific methodologies or statistical techniques for constructing an index [ 11 ]. Building on this framework, we intend to develop an Urban Deprivation Index. This index will integrate the identified indicators to capture the multidimensional nature of urban challenges, offering a more comprehensive understanding compared to traditional income-based poverty measures. Methodologies for combining these indicators into a cohesive index will be explored in subsequent studies, drawing on relevant literature and established practices for index creation.
source_label: Study protocol for developing an urban deprivation index in Nepal: Data review, measurement, visualization and real-world application in urban poverty alleviation
